name: One Business Hub
headline: MAKE YOUR NEXT MOVE.
lede: Company formation, PRO services, accounting and business concierge support in Dubai and across the UAE. Your ambition. Our expertise. One hub.
services: Big ambition. Small details. We see both.
Your business. All the moving parts.
about: With 10+ years of UAE industry experience, One Business Hub brings business setup, visas and corporate services together. From your first licence to visas, office space, banking preparation and accounting, you have one local team to help you move forward.

Established in 2018 and led by Zukhra Yessengarina, OBH brings 10+ years of industry experience to business setup, visas and ongoing company support. Clear conversations. Practical next steps. A partner you can reach.
